story.body: You came out after the second glass, said where you mean to stand tomorrow, and did not start the letter in the churchyard. Verbeke kept to Norwich. The loaf stayed a thumb short.

participation.context: Two pounds since August are still out. He was not asked.

story.body: You listed what is already spoken for, and you left the coffer's own figure off the leaf. Nothing in the column was paid today.

title: Wrote the column of what is spoken for

story.body: You preferred the sum before you knew it, and you kept the promised column instead of a total.
